title: Reading Drill — Checking a new market awning — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Checking a new market awning — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Cairnford, work on water dripping at one end onto a busy walkway had already produced a small collection of chalk outlines. The market buildings team used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: the area wetted during showers.

**B** The group kept a slight change in the angle for the new trial, which was planned to run for nine weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that wind during rain should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
